chunks: And ʿAlī عليه السلام used to say:

Whoever dies while holding the capital of a mudarabah partnership: if he specifically identifies it before his death and says, 'This belongs to so-and-so,' then it belongs to him. But if he dies and does not mention it, then it is treated equally with the claims of the creditors.

key_terms.أُسْوَةُ الْغُرَمَاءِ: treated on equal footing with the creditors
key_terms.مَالُ الْمُضَارَبَةِ: the investment capital held in a mudarabah partnership

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone dies while holding mudarabah capital?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about capital held in a mudarabah partnership when the holder dies. If the specific property is identified before death as belonging to its owner, it is returned to that owner; otherwise, it is treated together with the estate in relation to the creditors' claims.
